name: MonarchMessageComposer
title: MessageComposer
summary: The box where people write a message: plain text with @mentions, attachments, an emoji button, reply and edit modes, message types, a character limit, a draft status and a send button.
whenToUse: At the bottom of a chat, a comment thread or a support conversation, under the messages.
whenNotToUse: For a prompt to an AI assistant, use the intelligence components such as MonarchAiConversation. For a single-line field in a form, use MonarchTextField. For formatted text, wait for the rich text editor; this composer writes plain text.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMessageComposer(label: String, state: TextFieldState, onSend: suspend (MonarchMessageComposerMessage) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, editing: Boolean = false, sending: Boolean = false, hasAttachments: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, replyTo: MonarchMessageComposerReply? = null, modes: List<MonarchMessageComposerMode> = emptyList(), selectedMode: String? = null, onModeChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, mentions: MonarchMessageComposerMentions? = null, draftStatus: MonarchSaveStatus = MonarchSaveStatus.Idle, sendShortcut: MonarchMessageComposerSendShortcut = MonarchMessageComposerSendShortcut.Enter, maxLength: Int? = null, typingIntervalMillis: Long = 3_000L, disabledReason: String? = null, labels: MonarchMessageComposerLabels = MonarchMessageComposerLabels(), onAttach: (() -> Unit)? = null, onDismissReply: (() -> Unit)? = null, onCancelEdit: (() -> Unit)? = null, onEditLast: (() -> Unit)? = null, onTyping: (() -> Unit)? = null, onTypingStop: (() -> Unit)? = null, attachIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, emojiIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, dismissIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, emojiPicker: (@Composable (onPick: (String) -> Unit, onDismiss: () -> Unit) -> Unit)? = null, attachments: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchMessageComposerMessage(text: String, mentions: List<MonarchMentionItem> = emptyList(), mode: String? = null)
class MonarchMessageComposerReply(author: String, excerpt: String? = null)
class MonarchMessageComposerMode(value: String, label: String, note: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, sendLabel: String? = null)

class MonarchMessageComposerMentions(suggestions: List<MonarchMentionItem>, status: MonarchMentionPickerStatus = MonarchMentionPickerStatus.Ready, triggers: Set<Char> = setOf('@'), onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onQueryChange: (MonarchMentionQuery?) -> Unit)

class MonarchMessageComposerLabels(send: String? = null, save: String? = null, sending: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, attach: String? = null, emoji: String? = null, modes: String? = null, replyingTo: ((String) -> String)? = null, dismissReply: String? = null, editing: String? = null, remaining: ((Int) -> String)? = null, draftSaving: String? = null, draftSaved: String? = null, draftError: String? = null, mentionPicker: MonarchMentionPickerLabels = MonarchMentionPickerLabels())

options.name: label
options.description: The accessible name of the text field, such as Message #design.

options.name: state
options.description: The text. The app owns it, so it saves and restores drafts.

options.name: onSend
options.description: Receives the trimmed text, the mentions still in it and the mode. The send button shows Sending… while it runs; the text clears when it returns and stays when it throws.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the composer.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Off, the text cannot be edited, nothing can be sent and the emoji button is hidden.

options.name: editing
options.description: Edits an existing message: an Editing message context, Save instead of Send, Cancel with onCancelEdit, and focus on the field.

options.name: sending
options.description: Shows the sending state, for apps that track sending themselves.

options.name: hasAttachments
options.description: Allows sending without text.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown while the text is empty. A mode's placeholder wins.

options.name: replyTo
options.description: The message being answered: Replying to the author, with a one-line excerpt.

options.name: modes
options.description: Message types as Material 3 segmented buttons above the box. A note mode gives the box the warning look.

options.name: selectedMode
options.description: The selected mode's value. The composer keeps the selection, starting with the first mode, when null.

options.name: onModeChange
options.description: Receives the value of the mode the person picks.

options.name: mentions
options.description: Mention suggestions. The composer reports the query; the app searches and passes results. Picking writes @Label and a space.

options.name: draftStatus
options.description: The app's draft save state, shown with MonarchSaveStatusIndicator as Saving draft…, Draft saved or Draft not saved.

options.name: sendShortcut
options.description: Enter: hardware Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line. CtrlEnter: only Ctrl+Enter or Meta+Enter sends.

options.name: maxLength
options.description: The most characters. Shows the characters left; over the limit the count turns danger and sending is off.

options.name: typingIntervalMillis
options.description: The least time between two onTyping calls.

options.name: disabledReason
options.description: Why the composer is disabled, shown under it while enabled is false.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the mention picker's.

options.name: onAttach
options.description: Adds the attach button. Open the app's photo picker or document picker, such as PickVisualMedia.

options.name: onDismissReply
options.description: Adds a button named Stop replying that removes the reply context.

options.name: onCancelEdit
options.description: Adds Cancel while editing; Escape on a hardware keyboard calls it.

options.name: onEditLast
options.description: Up on a hardware keyboard in an empty box, to edit the last message.

options.name: onTyping
options.description: Called at most once per typingIntervalMillis while the focused text changes.

options.name: onTypingStop
options.description: Called after onTyping when the text is emptied or sent, focus leaves, or the composer leaves the screen.

options.name: attachIcon
options.description: The attach button's icon, a MonarchIcon with a null description. The button shows its name as text without it.

options.name: emojiIcon
options.description: The emoji button's icon. Text without it.

options.name: dismissIcon
options.description: The icon of the button that removes the reply context. Text without it.

options.name: emojiPicker
options.description: The app's emoji picker, shown while the emoji button is open; the emoji is inserted at the caret. Adds the emoji button.

options.name: attachments
options.description: The attachment row above the text, such as MonarchAttachmentChips. Wraps onto new rows.

options.name: actions
options.description: Extra buttons before the send button.

states.name: empty
states.description: The placeholder in the subtle text color; the send button is disabled.

states.name: ready
states.description: Text or attachments present: the send button is enabled.

states.name: sending
states.description: The send button shows a spinner and reads Sending…; another send is blocked.

states.name: replying
states.description: A context row with Replying to the author, the excerpt and a Stop replying button.

states.name: editing
states.description: A context row with Editing message, a Cancel button and Save instead of Send.

states.name: note mode
states.description: The box uses the subtle warning fill and the warning border; the send label can change, such as Add note.

states.name: over the limit
states.description: The count is negative in the strong danger color and the send button is disabled.

states.name: focused
states.description: The Monarch focus ring around the box.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Subtle fill and border, disabled text color, no emoji button, and the reason under the box.

states.name: draft status
states.description: Saving draft…, Draft saved or Draft not saved under the box.

appearance: The box is the surface color with the input border and the container radius; a note mode uses the subtle warning fill and the warning border, and a disabled composer the subtle fill and border with disabled text. The placeholder is subtle text, the caret the solid accent, the count muted or strong danger over the limit. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web composer is a rich text editor with a formatting toolbar; Android writes plain text until the rich text editor exists, so mentions are written as @Label, as on iOS, and reported as items. On the web Enter sends; on Android the on-screen keyboard's Enter adds a line and the send button sends, while a hardware keyboard's Enter (or Ctrl+Enter) sends, detected by the absence of the soft-keyboard flag on the key event. The web shows a send-key hint under the box; Android does not, because most people type on the on-screen keyboard. Files arrive by paste, drop and picker on the web; on Android onAttach lets the app open the system photo picker or document picker. Monarch has no emoji picker on Android yet (androidx.emoji2:emoji2-emojipicker is not a dependency), so the emoji button appears only with the app's emojiPicker; the emoji is inserted at the caret, which iOS cannot do. Monarch bundles no icons: the attach, emoji and dismiss buttons show their names as text until the app gives icons. onSend is a suspending function, the Kotlin form of iOS's async throws. Draft debouncing is the app's: it owns the TextFieldState. sendShortcut is Enter or CtrlEnter (iOS returnKey or commandReturn) and booleans have no is prefix. Experimental: a domain pattern until a Rook app adopts it.
accessibility: The text field is named by label; the placeholder is drawn inside it.
The reply or edit context is one TalkBack element read as its title and excerpt; the dismiss button is separate and named Stop replying.
The attach, emoji and dismiss buttons are named, with touch targets of at least 48dp, as icon buttons or text buttons.
The send button is a MonarchButton; while sending it reads Sending….
The character count is read as characters left, or characters over the limit, not as a bare number.
Mention suggestions use MonarchMentionPicker, which announces the result count while focus stays in the text field.
The note mode is named by its segment as well as shown by the warning tint; the segments are named Message type.
The text field reserves 48dp and grows from one to eight lines with the font size, then scrolls.
edgeCases: Text of only spaces cannot be sent; sent text is trimmed.
A mention picked mid-sentence reuses the space after it, so there are never two.
A mention whose @Label was edited away is not sent in mentions.
Typing over the limit is allowed; sending is not, as on the web and iOS.
Text typed while onSend runs is cleared with the sent text when onSend returns.
Hardware key handling can only be confirmed on a device with a keyboard; in tests key events without the soft-keyboard flag stand in for one.

examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    MonarchMessageComposer(
        label = {{label}},
        state = state,
        onSend = { message ->
            // Post message.text to the server here.
            replying = false
        },
        placeholder = {{placeholder}},
        replyTo = if (replying) MonarchMessageComposerReply({{replyTo.author}}, {{replyTo.excerpt}}) else null,
        onDismissReply = { replying = false },
        dismissIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
        actions = {
            MonarchEditorToolbar(
                onAction = {},
                scrollable = false,
                groups = listOf(
                    listOf(MonarchEditorTool.Bold, MonarchEditorTool.Italic, MonarchEditorTool.Strikethrough, MonarchEditorTool.Code),
                    listOf(MonarchEditorTool.BulletList, MonarchEditorTool.OrderedList),
                    listOf(MonarchEditorTool.Link),
                    listOf(MonarchEditorTool.Blockquote),
                    listOf(MonarchEditorTool.CodeBlock),
                ),
            )
            MonarchButton(
                text = {{emoji}},
                onClick = { state.edit { append({{emoji}}) } },
                variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost,
                size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm,
            )
        },
    )
    MonarchText(text = "Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line", style = MonarchTextStyle.Caption, color = MonarchTheme.colors.textMuted)
}

examples.title: A support reply with an internal note mode
examples.setup:
val state = rememberTextFieldState()
var mode by remember { mutableStateOf("reply") }
examples.code:
MonarchMessageComposer(
    label = "Reply to customer",
    state = state,
    onSend = { message -> /* Send message.text as message.mode. */ },
    modes = listOf(
        MonarchMessageComposerMode("reply", "Reply"),
        MonarchMessageComposerMode("note", "Internal note", note = true, sendLabel = "Add note"),
    ),
    selectedMode = mode,
    onModeChange = { mode = it },
    draftStatus = MonarchSaveStatus.Saved,
    sendShortcut = MonarchMessageComposerSendShortcut.CtrlEnter,
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web composer is 560px wide: its reply banner sits above the box and the whole toolbar (ten tools, the emoji button and Send) fits one row. A phone is 344dp wide and each tool keeps a 48dp touch target, so the tools share one row that scrolls sideways beside Send and the later tools are reached by scrolling. The reply context is the first row inside the box, so it stays attached to the field it answers.
parityExceptions.convention: Material touch target of 48dp; a toolbar that does not fit scrolls sideways on a compact window
